content.title: Broadcast Info - Utah Jazz
content.text: Watch the Jazz At home or on the roadExperience the thrill of Utah Jazz games seamlessly with Jazz+, the team's exclusive streaming platform. Jazz+ offers the flexibility of watching live and on-demand games whether you're at home or on-the-go in Utah and surrounding areas, with over 80 local games available for your viewing pleasure. Now, you can stream the action straight to your smartphone, tablet, or computer. Jazz+ extends its streaming service to smart TV apps, making it accessible on Apple TV, Android TV, Roku, and Samsung. Besides live game broadcasts through KJZZ, Jazz+ brings you live pre and post-game shows, on-demand viewing of full-length or condensed games and highlights, and exclusive team content, with an added option of Spanish play-by-play and analysis, making it your comprehensive portal to everything Utah Jazz.Jazz+ is now available throughout the state of Utah, Idaho and parts of Wyoming, Montana, Nevada, Oregon and Washington.If you are outside of the Jazz+ coverage area, sign up for NBA League PassWatch the Jazz At home or on the roadJazz+ territories have expanded.
